title: FOLIO: Natural Language Reasoning with First-Order Logic
authors_zh: Simeng Han 等（Yale University、Harvard University、NVIDIA、Iowa City West High School 等）
paper_type_zh: EMNLP 2024 main / arXiv 的 formalizable reasoning benchmark
best_for_zh: 关注 benchmark、评分契约、污染风险、评测 harness 和后训练反馈可复用性的研究者。
one_line: FOLIO exposes first-order logic reasoning in natural language as an auditable evaluation surface.
FOLIO 把自然语言形式的一阶逻辑推理做成可审计的评测面。
why: Useful for formalizable reasoning surface and label consistency checks.
inclusion_reason: Useful for formalizable reasoning surface and label consistency checks.

title: Problem
问题
html: FOLIO asks how to test natural-language reasoning where examples can be represented and checked with first-order logic. The primary sources are arXiv:2209.00840 and the EMNLP 2024 ACL Anthology record. It belongs here as a logical-reasoning benchmark, not as a formal-proof corpus. A sample contains natural-language premises, a hypothesis or question, a gold truth label, and associated first-order-logic annotations used to verify consistency during dataset construction. Its atlas value is the bridge between natural language reasoning labels and formalizable semantic checks.

FOLIO 关注的问题是：如何评测可以用一阶逻辑表示和检查的自然语言推理。主要来源是 arXiv:2209.00840 和 EMNLP 2024 ACL Anthology 记录。这里收录它是因为它是 logical-reasoning benchmark，而不是形式化证明语料。一个样本包含自然语言 premises、hypothesis 或 question、gold truth label，以及构造阶段用于一致性核验的一阶逻辑标注。它对 atlas 的价值是连接自然语言推理标签和可形式化语义检查。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a benchmark of 1,430 examples built from 487 premise sets, with first-order-logic annotations used to validate the reasoning labels. The mechanism writes natural-language premises and hypotheses, maps them into FOL, checks annotations with an inference engine, and evaluates models by gold-label accuracy. The feedback contract for model scoring is answer-level classification; the programmatic component audits annotation consistency. Closest comparisons are RTE/NLI datasets, ProofWriter, and formal-logic benchmarks. The direction label is formalizable natural-language reasoning.

核心贡献是 1,430 个 examples、487 个 premise sets 的 benchmark，并用一阶逻辑标注验证推理标签。机制是编写自然语言 premises 和 hypotheses，映射到 FOL，用 inference engine 检查标注，再按 gold-label accuracy 评测模型。模型评分的反馈契约是 answer-level classification；程序化部分主要用于审计标注一致性。最近对比是 RTE/NLI 数据集、ProofWriter 和 formal-logic benchmark。方向标签是 formalizable natural-language reasoning。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Inputs: natural-language premises, hypotheses, FOL translations, and target labels. 2. Pipeline: author premise sets, translate statements into first-order logic, use an inference engine to verify labels, release natural-language examples, and score models against gold labels. 3. Outputs: benchmark examples, labels, FOL annotations, and official data zip. 4. Feedback: model success is gold-label accuracy, while FOL checking supports dataset validity. 5. Reuse requires pinning ACL data zip, label set, any FOL annotations used, and prompt/scoring format.

1. 输入：自然语言 premises、hypotheses、FOL translations 和目标标签。2. 流程：编写 premise sets，将语句翻译成一阶逻辑，用 inference engine 验证标签，发布自然语言样本，并按 gold labels 给模型评分。3. 输出：benchmark examples、labels、FOL annotations 和官方 data zip。4. 反馈：模型成功由 gold-label accuracy 决定，FOL 检查支持数据有效性。5. 复用前要固定 ACL data zip、label set、使用的 FOL annotations 和 prompt/scoring 格式。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The key evidence is the dataset scale of 1,430 examples over 487 premise sets and the use of first-order-logic inference to validate annotations. Row-level evidence is the gold label backed by the premise set and FOL consistency check, not a proof generated by the evaluated model. Scores are bounded by the prompt format, label mapping, and whether a model is asked to output only the answer or also reasoning.
关键证据是 487 个 premise sets 上的 1,430 个 examples，以及用一阶逻辑 inference 验证标注。逐样本证据是由 premise set 和 FOL 一致性检查支撑的 gold label，而不是被评测模型生成的证明。分数受 prompt 格式、标签映射，以及模型是否只输出答案或还输出推理影响。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior NLI datasets often rely on natural-language labels without a formal semantic audit. FOLIO changes the construction by pairing natural-language examples with FOL annotations. The direction signal is that reasoning benchmarks can use formal tools to audit label consistency. What is not new is multiple-choice or label-based reasoning evaluation. Before reuse, inspect translation fidelity, ambiguity in natural language, label balance, and whether FOL annotations are available for the intended split.
已有 NLI 数据集常依赖自然语言标签，缺少形式语义审计。FOLIO 的变化是把自然语言样本和 FOL annotations 配对。方向信号是 reasoning benchmark 可以用形式工具审计标签一致性。多选或标签式推理评测本身并不新。复用前要查翻译忠实度、自然语言歧义、标签平衡，以及目标 split 是否有可用 FOL 标注。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is only as good as the natural-language-to-FOL translation. A formally valid label may still miss pragmatic ambiguity, and a model's natural-language reasoning can be correct while its label is judged wrong under the dataset interpretation. FOLIO is not a proof assistant benchmark, and gold-label accuracy does not verify a model's internal reasoning path. Public examples can contaminate later models.
正确性取决于自然语言到 FOL 的翻译质量。形式上有效的标签仍可能忽略语用歧义；模型自然语言推理可能合理，但按数据集解释标签错误。FOLIO 不是 proof assistant benchmark，gold-label accuracy 不验证模型内部推理路径。公开样本可能污染后续模型。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use FOLIO as a schema for formalizable reasoning benchmarks. Preserve premise set id, natural-language statements, FOL translation, gold label, inference-engine verdict, split, and prompt format. It is useful for checking whether a reasoning dataset has an audit path beyond annotator agreement.
可把 FOLIO 用作 formalizable reasoning benchmark schema。复用时保留 premise set id、自然语言语句、FOL translation、gold label、inference-engine verdict、split 和 prompt 格式。它适合检查 reasoning 数据是否有超越标注者一致性的审计路径。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Keep two contracts separate: FOL validation of dataset labels and answer-level scoring of models. Read the examples where natural language and logic diverge before treating FOLIO as purely programmatic evaluation.
要分开两个契约：FOL 对数据标签的验证，以及模型的 answer-level scoring。把 FOLIO 当成纯程序化评测前，先读自然语言和逻辑表示可能分歧的例子。
